svg.aria-description: Parcelpoint on Azure: 23 nodes, 22 connections. 30 resources on Azure, framed by the module that declares them and nested in the groups, networks, and subnets that hold them, imported from Terraform. An arrow means one resource refers to another, and its label says how: a role, a private link, logs, or a secret.
svg.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Parcelpoint on Azure
svg.desc: Parcelpoint on Azure: 23 nodes, 22 connections. 30 resources on Azure, framed by the module that declares them and nested in the groups, networks, and subnets that hold them, imported from Terraform. An arrow means one resource refers to another, and its label says how: a role, a private link, logs, or a secret. Nodes: - Account: Azure subscription - Resource group: rg-parcel-prod (westeurope) - Observability: Monitoring (Module modules/monitoring) - log-parcel-prod (Log Analytics workspace PerGB2018), service - appi-parcel-prod (Application Insights web), service - Resource group: Compute (Module modules/compute) - id-parcel-prod-apps (Managed identity), identity - Service plan: asp-parcel-prod - app-parcel-prod-api (App Service), service - func-parcel-prod-events (Function app), function - Service plan (P1v3 Linux), service - Virtual network: Network (Module modules/network) - privatelink.postgres.database.azure.com (Private DNS zone), gateway - Virtual network: vnet-parcel-prod - Virtual network, service - Subnet: snet-parcel-prod-app - nsg-parcel-prod-app (Network security group), secret - Subnet, service - Subnet: snet-parcel-prod-data - Subnet, service - Subnet: snet-parcel-prod-endpoints - Subnet, service - Resource group: Data (Module modules/data) - pe-parcel-prod-labels (Private endpoint), gateway - Data tier: psql-parcel-prod - Postgres password, service - Tracking database (GP_Standard_D2ds_v5), database - tracking (Database), database - Storage: stparcelprodlabels - smoke-dead-letters (Storage queue), queue - Shipping labels (Storage account, label PDFs), storage - labels (Blob container), storage - Messaging: sb-parcel-prod - Service Bus namespace (Standard), queue - Carrier events (Service Bus queue), queue - Security: kv-parcel-prod - Key Vault (standard), secret - postgres-password (Secret), secret Connections: - appi-parcel-prod to log-parcel-prod: logs - nsg-parcel-prod-app to log-parcel-prod: diagnostics - privatelink.postgres.database.azure.com to Virtual network: DNS link - Tracking database to Subnet: subnet - Tracking database to privatelink.postgres.database.azure.com: DNS - Tracking database to Postgres password (identity line): password - pe-parcel-prod-labels to Shipping labels (private network line): private link - pe-parcel-prod-labels to Subnet: subnet - postgres-password to Postgres password: holds - id-parcel-prod-apps to Shipping labels (identity line): Storage Blob Data Contributor - id-parcel-prod-apps to Service Bus namespace (identity line): Azure Service Bus Data Receiver - id-parcel-prod-apps to Key Vault (identity line): Key Vault Secrets User - Service plan to Subnet (private network line): VNet integration (2) - Service plan to appi-parcel-prod: telemetry (2) - Service plan to Tracking database (stored data line): data (2) - app-parcel-prod-api to postgres-password (identity line): secret - Service plan to Shipping labels (stored data line): storage (2) - Service plan to id-parcel-prod-apps (identity line): identity (2) - func-parcel-prod-events to Carrier events (asynchronous line): messages - smoke-dead-letters to Shipping labels: part of - tracking to Tracking database: part of - labels to Shipping labels: part of
